excluded: Printed page number '3' (bottom right corner) and a faint, mirrored show-through of a page number in the left margin (about 25 px, not printed on this page).
page_notes: Western romance. Scan is slightly curved toward the spine on the right. The opening caption is free-floating text set on a steep upward slant (each line rotated roughly 15-20 degrees), a hard layout case. Lettering is upper case with bold-italic emphasis words.

regions.text: SCARRED AND DISFIGURED, LILLI ANDREY BROODED AND SULKED, CAREFULLY PLOTTED HER REVENGE--AND DAYS LATER, TOGETHER WITH HER HENCHMEN...
regions.notes: No box: italic lettering on the page margin, each line slanted upward. Red drop initial 'S'. 'REVENGE' is followed by a long dash at the line end (drawn as one long stroke); written as '--'. The surname reads ANDREY; the R is clear.

regions.text: MISS PRISCILLA AND HER FOREMAN ARE DOWN IN THE CANYON NOW, LILLI.
GOOD, I'VE BEEN WAITING A LONG, LONG TIME TO GET HER ALONE...
...AND NOW SHE'S GOING TO PAY FOR THIS SCAR SHE GAVE ME! SHE BRANDED ME BEFORE, AND NOW IT'S MY TURN TO DO THE SAME TO HER! COME ON!
MEANWHILE, IN THE CANYON AHEAD, A WOLF PACK CORNERS HELPLESS PREY... HOWLING WILDLY, THE KILLERS POUNCE...
regions.notes: Dark lettering on a yellow caption box; red drop initial 'M'.

regions.text: BUT FROM THE LEDGE ABOVE, THE SNARL OF AMBUSH LEAD!
regions.notes: Dark lettering on yellow; red drop initial 'B'.

regions.text: THOSE CATTLE LURED 'EM INTO THE OPEN, M'AM!
regions.notes: Drawn as M'AM (apostrophe after the M), kept as lettered.

regions.text: AND ABOUT TIME--THEY'VE BEEN PICKING OFF TOO MANY OF OUR HERD!
regions.notes: Dash drawn as a single long stroke with spaces either side ('TIME — THEY'VE'); written as '--'.

regions.text: GOT MOST OF THEM--AND THE OTHERS ARE RUNNING OFF! I DON'T THINK THEY'LL BE BACK SO SOON...
regions.notes: Long dash at line end after THEM, written as '--'.

regions.text: QUICK! DON'T LET THEM GET AWAY--I'VE BEEN WAITING TOO LONG FOR THIS!
regions.notes: 'QUICK!' is bold italic. Long dash at line end after AWAY, written as '--'.

regions.text: SHE'S A HELLCAT, MISS--RUN FOR THE HORSES!
regions.notes: Dash drawn as a single long stroke with spaces; written as '--'.

regions.text: LILLI! STOP THIS, HAVE YOU GONE COMPLETELY MAD?

details: Region 7: first pass wrote MA'M; the lettering is M'AM.
